objective: Allow project members to maintain multiple non-overlapping project release-calendar entries over inclusive start/end date ranges and see each entry on every covered calendar day.

requirements.statement: Keep the release-calendar project tab and existing tab routes usable.
acceptance: Direct and interactive tab navigation load the calendar.

requirements.statement: Persist multiple project release-calendar entries with title, inclusive release_start_date, release_end_date and remark; equal dates represent one day and overlapping active ranges are rejected.
acceptance: A cross-month entry is returned by every intersecting month
A non-overlapping second entry is accepted
An overlapping active range is rejected
counterexample: A project can save two active release-calendar entries covering the same date.

requirements.statement: Authorize project members on the server for calendar reads and writes.
acceptance: Non-members and cross-tenant callers are denied

requirements.statement: Use desktop month and mobile date-grouped presentations with inclusive range expansion.
acceptance: Required desktop/mobile viewports have no page-level horizontal overflow
Cross-month ranges appear in all intersecting months

requirements.statement: Preserve release-window-inspired project tab styling and theme readability.
acceptance: Existing tabs remain usable and theme-readable
counterexample: Navigation becomes inaccessible in a theme.

invariants: Server-side tenant, membership, entity, optimistic-lock and audit controls apply
release_start_date is not after release_end_date and endpoints are inclusive
constraints: Only REQ-081 writable paths may change
Do not modify V214 or unrelated REQ-084 changes

assumptions.text: Existing project membership guard remains the authority for calendar editing.
assumptions.basis: Approved REQ-081 design and user confirmation.

decisions.question: How should a range be represented?
options: One record with inclusive start/end dates
decisions.selected: One record with inclusive start/end dates

measurement_intents.observable: Project tab route and content load
Daily markers and page width at required viewports
